content: Both the Prototipo RS - Black/Red and the Prototipo RS - Red/Black/Orange models feature all-day comfort and versatility. They include additional comfort padding on the tongue, heel, and collar. For hygiene, they are equipped with an ONSTEAM anti-microbial lining to help with moisture and odor control. Additionally, they come with a removable, contoured cork and EVA foam insole featuring a perforated footbed. These shoes are crafted with high-quality materials inspired by luxury automotive standards to ensure excellent quality with every step.
